pr.body:
## Summary
- Repairs PR Steward semantics so review comments tied to resolved or outdated review threads stop blocking readiness.
- Adds explicit proof freshness support for exact-head and supervisor-accepted self-reference exception semantics.
- Keeps PR Steward check-only and fail-closed on unresolved current threads, stale proof, or unknown reviewers.

## Scope
Check-only review-intake semantics only. No GitHub mutation, no thread resolution, no merge queue mutation, and no changes to PR #713 runtime code.

## Validation
Run schema parsing, focused PR Steward tests, fixture smoke tests, compileall, and git diff --check.

## NOT_RUN
No live GitHub mutation and no merge operations by design.
